event.description:
Join us for a fireside chat with David Rhew, Chief Medical Officer and VP of Healthcare at Microsoft.
The conversation will explore the rapidly evolving intersection of AI, healthcare, and AI for science. We’ll discuss how Artificial Intelligence is transforming healthcare delivery and clinical decision-making, and scientific innovation.
The session will bring together students, researchers, founders, investors, and industry leaders interested in the future of healthcare and AI.
About David Rhew:
Dr. David C. Rhew is the Global Chief Medical Officer (CMO) & VP of Healthcare for Microsoft. He is Adjunct Professor at Stanford University; holds six U.S. technology patents that enable authoring, mapping, and integration of clinical decision support into electronic health records; and has been recognized as one of the 50 most influential clinician executives by Modern Healthcare.
Dr. Rhew received his Bachelors of Science degrees in computer science and cellular molecular biology from University of Michigan. He received his MD degree from Northwestern University and completed internal medicine residency at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center. He completed fellowships in health services research at Cedars-Sinai and infectious diseases at the University of California, Los Angeles.
He has served as CMO and VP for Samsung; SVP and CMO at Zynx Health Incorporated; clinician/researcher at the VA Greater Los Angeles Healthcare System and RAND; and Associate Clinical Professor of Medicine at UCLA. Dr. Rhew has served on the National Quality Forum’s Executive Committee for Consensus Standards and Approval, Chaired the Consumer Technology Association Health Technology Board, and sits on the Governing Committee for NESTcc (National Evaluation System for health Technology coordinating center), the medical device advisory group for the FDA, CMS, and NIH.

​Funders & Founders: State of the Market
Thursday, October 29 · 3:00–7:00 PMKSC Silicon Valley
SEE CONFIRMED SPEAKERS BELOW
Please join Five Star Bank, KSC Silicon Valley, Band of Angels, TriNet, and Turing for an afternoon and early evening of insights, discussion, and connection with founders, investors, and operators shaping the future of innovation.
Through a series of focused panel discussions, we'll explore how AI is transforming company building, venture investing, valuations, fundraising, scaling strategies, and exit opportunities. From pre-seed stage investing to liquidity markets, this program brings together leading voices from across the venture ecosystem to discuss the trends defining the next generation of start-ups.
Highlights include a featured fireside conversation with former Calm CEO David Ko, investor panels exploring AI's impact across industries, start-up spotlight presentations, and conversations around fundraising, secondaries, and venture market dynamics.
Whether you're building, investing, or advising high-growth companies, expect practical insights, candid perspectives, and meaningful opportunities to connect with leaders from across Silicon Valley.

📈 State of the Venture MarketHear directly from leading investors on fundraising conditions, valuations, company formation, scaling strategies, exit environments, and where capital is flowing today.
🤖 AI Across the EconomyExplore how artificial intelligence is transforming consumer experiences, enterprise software, healthcare, infrastructure, autonomy, cybersecurity, data platforms, and investment opportunities.
🚀 Founder SpotlightsMeet emerging start-ups through a series of rapid-fire founder presentations showcasing innovative companies and new technologies.

You asked. We listened. So we’re doing it again.
FDE Conference I and II filled up within a week, bringing together hundreds of FDEs, founders, and operators building at the forefront of AI.
Now we’re back for round three.
​The FDE Conference III + Hiring Fair
Join us in San Francisco on October 29th from 3-9 PM for a day dedicated entirely to the people building, leading, and scaling forward deployed teams.
Expect candid fireside chats, tactical breakout sessions, small-group conversations, and a dedicated FDE Hiring Fair + Company Showcase bringing together companies building forward deployed teams and people looking for their next role.
​FDE Hiring Fair + Company Showcase
A major part of this year’s conference will be our FDE Hiring Fair, bringing together companies actively building and growing forward deployed teams with FDEs, engineers, and technical operators interested in what’s next.
Whether you’re actively looking for a new role, curious about which companies are hiring, or building an FDE organization yourself, you’ll have dedicated time to meet companies and candidates in person.
More than anything, this is a chance to meet other people building in a function that is still being defined in real time.
Space is limited. Register today!
​Schedule
3:00 - 3:30 pm: Arrival
3:30- 4:15 pm: Breakouts
4:30 - 5:15 pm: Fireside chat
5:15 - 5:45 pm: Company spotlights
5:45 - 9:00 pm: Hiring Fair and Happy Hour Networking
Speakers
Rochelle Mattern leads field engineering at Together AI, running the pre-sales and post-sales technical team embedded in Together's largest customers. Her team owns the technical outcomes across the full customer base and serves as the voice of the customer into Together's product, engineering, and research teams. She also works directly as a technical advisor to several key accounts, focused on the reliability and performance of production AI workloads at scale.
Jetashree Ravi leads part of the Applied ML Engineering team at Fireworks, where she focuses on making inference fast, reliable, and production-ready. She works across the stack—from improving deployment performance and reliability under load to helping customers successfully fine-tune and launch models. When a workload is slow, unstable, or not behaving as expected, she works with teams to diagnose the issue and build a scalable solution.
Jove Zhong is Head of Forward Deployed Engineering at Cresta, a $100M ARR enterprise AI company building the AI operating system for customer experience. In less than a year, he scaled Cresta’s FDE organization from 2 to over 50 people across seven countries, earning recognition as FDE Team of the Year at Propel 26. With 20+ years of enterprise software experience at IBM, EMC, and Splunk, and as co-founder of Timeplus, he shares practical FDE leadership lessons through his newsletter and video podcast, Forward Deployed Caffeine.
​About Nixo
Nixo helps forward deployed teams increase deployment capacity. Nixo brings customer context, engineering work, and project delivery together so FDE teams can ship faster, reuse what they build, and turn custom deployments into repeatable leverage.

12 Demos · RSVP 80 People
Agentic AI Day is a focused gathering for the founders, engineers, researchers, investors, and enterprise leaders building that future. Meet the builders on Thursday's afternoon. 🙌 12 live product and technical demos, feedback and conversation from VC and agentic AI teams. An curated room of approximately 80 attendees, Networking and Coffee!
Areas Focusing Here
Agent runtime, tool use, and multi-agent orchestration
Context, memory, retrieval, and agent-accessible data
Inference, serving, routing, caching, and scheduling
Evaluation, observability, security, and permissions

Interested in Speaking? Please let us know through partnership@openstagesai.com
Judge Feedback
We will invite a selected group of judges to evaluate the demos and provide direct feedback to each team. The judging group will include senior AI and infrastructure leaders, investors, and researchers or technical members from AI labs.
Join as Strategic Partners
Partners receive access to a curated group of Agentic AI founders, technical builders, enterprise leaders, and investors, as well as structured opportunities for follow-up.
For partnership inquiries, contact partnership@openstagesai.com.
Hospitality Partner
Infron AI
Infron gives teams unified access to leading AI models through one API, with intelligent routing, observability, and automatic fallbacks built in. It’s designed to help developers optimize cost, performance, and reliability without managing every provider separately. Scan the QR code to request free test credits and try it with your own workload!
Fidelity Private Shares
Fidelity Private Shares helps private companies manage equity with clarity and structure. Cap tables, valuations, governance, and planning tools work together in one system so founders and operators can stay investor-ready and manage ownership as complexity grows.
Community Partner
Keenable
Keenable is a web search API built for AI agents, in production at several AI labs. In a short live demo, we'll show an agent that searches the live web and reads any page as clean text in a fraction of a second, through a REST API or an MCP server that works in Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.
Glasser
Glasser is a data buffet for AI agents, providing access to premium data through one API key and a prepaid, pay-per-call model and no need for multiple subscriptions. Power workflows like lead generation, creator research, SEO audits, competitor analysis, and more.
Builders can get $10 in free Glasser Credits, enough for approximately 400 verified work emails, 10,000 LinkedIn profile lookups, or 20,000 keyword data points. That's roughly 2 months of everyday agent usage for a typical builder.
About the host:
OpenStages organizes curated Bay Area programs for founders and builders, including technical demo days, hackathons, salons, and closed-door sessions across AI and emerging technology.
